# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows, one line of text per worker."""

import typing

import hourglass.errors
import hourglass.models

MINUTES_PER_HOUR = 60


def timesheet_rows(
    shifts: typing.List[hourglass.models.Shift],
) -> typing.List[str]:
    """Name, shift count and hours per worker, busiest first."""
    if not shifts:
        raise hourglass.errors.ProjectError("no shifts given")

    counts = {}
    totals = {}
    for shift in shifts:
        name = shift.worker.strip()
        if not name:
            raise hourglass.errors.ProjectError("blank worker name")
        counts[name] = counts.get(name, 0) + 1
        totals[name] = totals.get(name, 0) + shift.span.minutes

    ranked = sorted(totals, key=lambda name: (-totals[name], name))
    return [
        f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, "
        f"{totals[name] / MINUTES_PER_HOUR:.1f} hours"
        for name in ranked
    ]


# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_timesheet.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

import hourglass.timesheet
import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.errors


def make_shift(worker, text):
    return hourglass.models.Shift(
        worker, "mon", hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text)
    )


class TimesheetRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_busiest_first(self):
        shifts = [
            make_shift("Ann", "09:00-10:30"),
            make_shift("Bob", "09:00-13:00"),
            make_shift("Ann", "11:00-12:00"),
        ]
        rows = hourglass.timesheet.timesheet_rows(shifts)
        self.assertEqual(
            rows,
            [
                "Bob: 1 shifts, 4.0 hours",
                "Ann: 2 shifts, 2.5 hours",
            ],
        )

    def test_empty_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.ProjectError):
            hourglass.timesheet.timesheet_rows([])

    def test_blank_worker_raises(self):
        shifts = [make_shift("  ", "09:00-10:00")]
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.ProjectError):
            hourglass.timesheet.timesheet_rows(shifts)


# end of file
EOF
